title: Canon name: the innkeeper is Borin Ironpot — never another name

Borin.description: Innkeeper of the Prancing Pony; human, bald, missing three fingers on his left hand
Borin.personality_traits: Warm to regulars, suspicious of armed strangers, proud of his cellar
Borin.combat_style: Hides behind the bar and shouts

llm_context.canon: Borin Ironpot is the innkeeper of the Prancing Pony. He is human, bald, and missing three fingers on his left hand.

canon_facts.fact: The innkeeper of the Prancing Pony is named Borin Ironpot.

script.speaker: Aria
script.message: I walk up to the bar and ask the innkeeper his name.

actions.text: Borin Ironpot, at your service. Mind the seven-fingered handshake — the left one's mostly decorative.
He polishes a tankard with a cloth that's seen better decades, watching your sword belt with an innkeeper's practised eye.
